items.title: Law 3
items.raw: 3. Copy on photography is judged by eye on the real image at review, never tested as a pair [documented, DECISIONS 2026-10-18: Eddie's ruling, Gate 2 question 4]: a photo has no single value to test. Since 2026-10-23 an image well holds a cleared image (Eddie owns the reference file's and the site's images, DECISIONS) or, for any other image, the grey placeholder (rule 8). White copy goes where the image is calm and dark enough under it; the 50 percent overlay (`background.scrim`, observed on 9 frames) is optional, the designer's call. The build reports copy over a placeholder as unchecked (its recorded entry in contrast-pairs), not as a failure.
